verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework for building your own agents. The evidence documents agent primitives and a Studio for testing user-built agents, but nothing shows a built-in, first-party AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. Agents a developer constructs are building blocks, and the MCP docs server serves documentation to external AI tools, so neither counts as an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
